# Fairness findings of IJ in the regular font which are known: kind x y direction status: reason.
inflection 693 428 90 intended: the right-hand edge of the stem runs from the convex outer edge of the tail straight up into the concave bracket of the right head serif, as on the right stem of n (as in J)
short 748 650 0 intended: the flat underside of the short right head serif (JHeadRight) between the end of its bracket and its tip, 10 units, which the width of the serif and the bracket of the capital stem leave (as in J)
